subject: a Russian writer of the 1860s and 1870s in his forties, with a high pale forehead, thinning light brown hair, a long untidy reddish-brown beard, deep-set intense grey eyes, wearing a plain dark frock coat and waistcoat

panels.01-moscow: a small boy in a simple 1820s Russian coat playing in the leafy garden of a large plain hospital building for the poor on the edge of Moscow, an old nanny in a headscarf watching from a bench, patients in long robes resting under the trees, early 19th century Russia, gentle morning light
panels.02-poorfolk: a thin young Russian man of 24 in an 1840s frock coat standing nervously in a candlelit Saint Petersburg study while an older bearded literary critic reads a handwritten manuscript at a desk piled with journals, another young man watching from the doorway, 1846, hopeful mood
panels.03-scaffold: a snowy square in Saint Petersburg on a grey December morning in 1849, a row of young prisoners in long plain white shirts standing in the snow before a line of soldiers with rifles held at rest, a horseman galloping in holding up a sealed letter, onlookers in winter coats, frozen breath, a tense moment of reprieve, no violence
panels.04-omsk: a young bearded Russian convict in a grey prison coat and leg irons sitting on a wooden bunk in a crowded log barracks in a Siberian prison camp in winter, reading a small worn New Testament by the light of a frosted window, other prisoners around him, 1850s, quiet endurance
panels.05-petersburg: {S} walking alone over a small bridge across a narrow canal in Saint Petersburg in the 1860s, tall yellow tenement buildings, a dusty summer evening, a thoughtful brooding mood, a notebook in his hand
panels.06-gambler: {S} pacing and dictating in a plain St Petersburg room in October 1866 while a young stenographer in a dark high-necked dress, Anna Snitkina, writes quickly in shorthand at a small table, lit only by two candles, a samovar on a side table, a dark wall with a small icon, nothing on the walls except the icon
panels.07-karamazov: an older {S} with grey in his beard writing late at night at a wooden desk in a quiet wooden house in a small Russian town in 1879, a glass of tea and a candle, pages of manuscript spread out, an icon in the corner of the room, deep concentration
panels.08-pushkin: an older {S} giving a speech from a stage in a packed Moscow hall in June 1880, the audience on its feet applauding, a laurel wreath on a table beside a bust of a poet with curly hair and side-whiskers, a moment of triumph, dignified
